description: This file defines a custom Android TextView called SkewableTextView, which supports skew transformations to enhance animation and visual effects by skewing text to the left or right.

classes.name: SkewableTextView
classes.description: A custom TextView that can be skewed horizontally to add anticipation and follow-through effects for animations.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the default onDraw to apply skew transformation before drawing the text.

methods.name: getSkewX
methods.description: Returns the current skew value applied to the text.

methods.name: setSkewX
methods.description: Sets the skew value; invalidates the view to trigger a redraw and skewed bounds update.

methods.name: invalidateSkewedBounds
methods.description: Calculates the transformed bounds of the skewed text and invalidates that area of the parent view to optimize redrawing.
